content.text:
Netlist and Micron Enter Patent License and Settlement Agreements: Netlist announced that it and Micron had entered patent-license and settlement agreements, including mutual settlement and release of pending legal proceedings, a five-year license covering Netlist patents including server DIMM and HBM technologies, and $30 million quarterly payments from Q4 2026 through Q3 2031, totaling $600 million. (time=2026-10-06T12:00:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Netlist, Inc. Form 8-K, filed October 6, 2026: The filing dates the settlement/release and patent-license agreements Oct. 5. It describes a worldwide, non-exclusive, non-transferable and non-sublicensable five-year license to Netlist’s worldwide patent portfolio and 20 quarterly $30 million fees totaling $600 million. It also discloses a securities purchase agreement for 10 million shares for $1 million, with closing contemplated on or before Oct. 6, and warns of collection risk for license amounts owed. (time=2026-10-06T12:05:21Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
